original_card.question: Can one uncovered interface implication be formalized with exact caller and certificate bindings?
methods: Formalize a missing boundary lemma identified by the selected review.
Audit a formal theorem-to-certificate binding independently.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State the exact formalized proposition and remaining assumptions; avoid duplicate arithmetic formalizations already present.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one missing statement with quantified hypotheses, actual caller and existing coverage. A compact-switch lemma is a candidate only after its mathematical contract is reviewed. Establish a bounded proof plan before a separately budgeted proof-assistant build; do not rerun large Lean jobs as orientation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

existing_checks.remaining: Exact theorem-to-caller binding and genuinely uncovered interface lemmas.
Uniform algorithmic implications, not another endpoint digit.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: compact-switch formalization proposed as future validation.
existing_checks.remaining: Audit the statement and assumptions before a formal proof campaign.

actual_scope: Recognize and recover all unknown projective Clifford terms in an exact tensor train. Prove width, support and observed-cut conditions and account for arithmetic, bit sizes and storage.
scope_change_reason: The donor requested a sustained cross-track synthesis of all 100 campaign packages. Current Bell-row and Gram-schedule results settle other output contracts. The remaining interface is whole-support recovery from the supplied cores.
bottleneck_link: A conditioned independent tensor dictionary does not by itself give an output-sensitive algorithm to find its occupied labels. This construction supplies that exact interface.
stop_rule: Verify both directions of membership, dimensions and costs, source character projections, a non-diagonal 19-label producer, adversarial off-model data and a separate dense oracle.
evidence: PROOF.md and SUPPORT.md contain the construction and support certificates. The registered verifier covers all stated computational checks. INVENTORY.md and SYNTHESIS.md account for the campaign and competing directions.
author: Ali Romman
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, adversarial checks and writing.

open_questions.question: Can a multiplication caller produce the required train and consume its outputs at a favorable complete cost?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The algorithm prices an exact supplied train. A native supplier needs an input owner, physical movement, arithmetic, storage and restoration.
open_questions.first_step: Specify one actual parent and child layout and derive the cost of constructing all local cores.
open_questions.blocked_by: No installed multiplication caller or native movement contract for this observation.

open_questions.question: Can exact support recognition extend to noisy input or to all supports at width thirteen?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Small perturbations change exact ranks, and arbitrary support at the threshold may exceed the proven two-flank criterion.
open_questions.first_step: Prove a support-separation criterion or construct a different exact support oracle at the threshold.
open_questions.blocked_by: A singular-value bound for the whole dictionary does not identify unknown support from a noisy train.
